thread:
Maya (People Ops): kicking off a quick coordination thread — PeerSpark micro-grants + sticker drop next Wed (on-campus). goal: hand out 20 micro-grants ($50 each) + stickers, and surface 10 peer-noms for shoutouts. need timeline, volunteers, approvals, and a tiny comms blurb. :sparkles:
Priya (People Ops): love it. schedule? I can do 11:30-1:30 for the table if that works.
Sam (Eng Manager): 11:30-1:30 is good for Eng folks. do we need manager sign-off for the micro-grants?
Maya (People Ops): manager OK ideally — quick AD hoc approval. plan: ppl nominate peers via form, awards approved by People Ops + manager, finance will cut digital gift cards.
Leah (Finance): confirm the $50 per grant (x20 = $1000) + ~$100 for stickers/shipping. we can use the team P-card, but need receipts + vendor invoice. please cc finance@redwood when you order.
Jorge (HRBP): can nominations be anonymous? some folks prefer that. also, any eligibility rules? full-time and contractors?
Maya (People Ops): good Q. nominations allowed anonymous, but we'll need a recipient email to send gift card. eligibility: all full-time + contractors with >3 months tenure. we'll add that to the form.
Anika (Ops): I can coordinate swag ordering. any sticker designs? last time we did the city skyline variant — we could reuse to save time.
Ethan (People Ops Intern): I made a draft comms blurb and a short Google form — link: https://forms.gle/pxxExample (draft). Nom fields: nominee name, nominee email, short reason (max 200 chars), manager OK checkbox (yes/no), anonymous toggle.
Priya (People Ops): quick UX ask — add a required "manager email" field only if manager approval checked. reduces follow-up.
Sam (Eng Manager): we'll push the comms to Eng channel after calendar invite. timeline: open noms Mon 9am, close Tues 5pm, awards distributed Wed at table. sound doable?
Maya (People Ops): timeline sounds good. volunteers: Priya + Anika for the table, Ethan to triage forms, Sam to help with crowd. need one more volunteer for printing name cards and scanning receipts.
Leah (Finance): receipts: screenshots of digital gift card orders are fine. send compiled invoice by Fri EOD. also need GL code — use 4201-people-culture.
Jorge (HRBP): comms blurb suggestion: short headline, eligibility line, "how to nominate" 1-2 steps, and photo of sample sticker. I can craft a version for managers.
Maya (People Ops): perfect. team, please drop any sticker art in #design-requests by EOD today. Anika, can you take vendor quote first thing tomorrow?
Anika (Ops): yes, I'll ping our previous vendor and get a 48hr turnaround quote.
rewards-bot: Nomination form created: https://forms.gle/pxxExample — 0 submissions so far. Use /rewards to see nom history.
Ethan (People Ops Intern): quick note — will prepare a 1-page list of nominees with manager email for approvals Tues morning.
Priya (People Ops): volunteer for printing & name cards. also can be backup at the table from 12:30-1:30.
Maya (People Ops): great — volunteers = Priya, Anika, Sam, Ethan. Jorge will review comms. Leah will process payment. next steps: 1) finalize sticker art, 2) vendor quote + order by tomorrow noon, 3) open form Mon 9am, 4) managers approve Tues morning, 5) table Wed 11:30-1:30.
Sam (Eng Manager): can we add a tiny sign that says "Nominate someone & pick up a sticker"? I'll print it.
Jorge (HRBP): I'll draft the manager note and share in threads later today.
Leah (Finance): FYI — if any award goes to a non-US contractor, we may need alternate payout method. flag any intl recipients early.
Maya (People Ops): noted. Ethan — can you add a country field on the form?
Ethan (People Ops Intern): added. form updated. link same.
Maya (People Ops): thanks all. final ask: if you're volunteering, react with :raised_hands: or reply. we'll use this thread as the coordination hub. :heart:
Sam (Eng Manager): :raised_hands:
Priya (People Ops): :raised_hands:
Anika (Ops): :raised_hands:
Ethan (People Ops Intern): :raised_hands:
Leah (Finance): :thumbsup:
Jorge (HRBP): :thumbsup:
